create_heightfield_terrain_programmatic: create a pybullet heightfield terrain from programmatic random height data using GEOM_HEIGHTFIELD collision shape
create_heightfield_terrain_from_png: create a pybullet heightfield terrain from a PNG file and apply a texture overlay using loadTexture
create_multibody_with_joints: create a pybullet multi-body object with revolute joints, link masses, and collision shapes
change_dynamics_friction: change the spinning friction, rolling friction, and linear damping of a pybullet body using changeDynamics
set_joint_motor_velocity_control: set joint motor control on a pybullet multi-body to velocity control with a target velocity and force
